# 2XceL Digital Media

> 2XceL Digital Media is a digital agency that builds custom, high-converting websites with marketing engineered into the backend, deploys 24/7 AI sales agents, produces AI-generated cinematic ad content, and runs done-for-you marketing. Led by Executive Director Christian Cométe, the company equips mid-market businesses and entrepreneurs for the Agentic Web. Tagline: Strategy, Automation, Growth.

## Core Services

- [Custom Web Design](https://2xcel.net/#custom-web-design): Hand-coded, fast, SEO-optimized websites with real-time analytics, automated lead capture, and marketing backends that convert visitors 24/7. From $3,500.
- [AI Agents & Automations](https://2xcel.net/#what-we-do): Voice agents that answer calls 24/7, lead scrapers, automated email/follow-up workflows, and custom chatbots. 25 prebuilt workplace agents across Customer Support, Sales, Marketing, Finance, HR, Operations, IT & Dev, and Specialized categories. $350 per agent; free base templates available.
- [AI Video & Creative Content](https://2xcel.net/#media-section): AI-generated product videos, professional photos, custom branded content, and social-ready ad creative — cinematic quality without physical shoots. From $1,500.
- [Done-For-You Marketing](https://2xcel.net/#pricing): Custom marketing strategy, ad campaigns, audience research and targeting, and monthly performance reporting. From $2,000/mo.

## Pricing

- [Build Your Own Plan](https://2xcel.net/#pricing): Modular pricing — select core services and AI agents, price updates live. No contracts, cancel anytime. Most setups go live in 2–4 weeks. Free 30-minute consultation, no obligation.
- Subscription tiers: Tier 1 (Complimentary Workspace Blueprints), Tier 2 (Core Growth & Implementation, $2,500), Tier 3 (Full Enterprise Infrastructure, custom).

## Key Facts

- Founder / Executive Director: Christian Cométe
- Service area: Worldwide
- Specialties: AI sales agents, custom web design, marketing automation, cinematic AI ad production
- Differentiator: Websites are engineered with marketing and lead automation built into the backend, not passive brochure sites. Live-qualifying dialogs convert far higher than static contact forms.
